page.content:
Lizard-hipped branch that includes theropods and sauropodomorphs.

How Saurischia connects

  • Topic: Dinosauria — Saurischia is one of the two great branches of Dinosauria.
  • Topic: Theropoda — Theropods are the bipedal predators and birds inside Saurischia.
  • Topic: Sauropoda — Sauropods are the long-necked giants inside Saurischia.

What is Saurischia?

Saurischia is the traditional hip-based division that holds meat-eating theropods and the long-necked sauropods, the two most public dinosaur body plans.

Key threads lead to Dinosauria, Theropoda and Sauropoda.
